{{Quote|We don't want to see any more families torn apart by this unreasonably violent so-called sport.|Deland Tyerell|<ref name="N45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|sports/13228_2.html|Podracing Banned on Caprioril}}</ref>}}
The '''Ratts Tyerell Foundation''' was an organization that attempted to outlaw [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]]. It was composed of people who had lost family members in the dangerous sport. The Foundation's chairman was the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Deland Tyerell/Legends|Deland Tyerell]], son of [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]].<ref name="N45" /> His safety crusade gained significant momentum and successfully lobbied for course modifications on over twelve [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="N49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}</ref> By [[23 BBY/Legends|13:2:28]], the Ratts Tyerell Foundation succeeded in pressuring the planet [[Caprioril]] into banning podracing completely.<ref name="N45" /> Podracing insiders alleged that the accomplishments of the Foundation was merely a convenient cover for an authoritarian crack-down from the upper levels of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] government, though this claim was flatly denied by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] aide, [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]].<ref name="N49" />
